messages:
Sasha: Heads up — seeing a sharp onboarding latency spike for the GPU fleet in us-west-2 after yesterday's egress firewall + audit-rollout. KMS decrypt errors are up in the logs.
Devon: Confirmed. New firewall rules tightened outbound to our keystore endpoints. A bunch of nodes are retrying decrypts, causing queueing.
Li: Observed provisioning timeouts: several nodes fail healthcheck during bootstrap, then requeue repeatedly.
keystore-bot: ALERT us-west-2: KMS decrypt error rate increased 8.2x in last 10m (code=Throttling, 429).
Sasha: Can someone paste the short error snippet?
Devon: logs from one agent: ```2024-04-27T18:12:08Z agent[pool-3]: keystore: decrypt failed: ThrottlingException: Rate exceeded
stack: /srv/agent/keystore/client.go:182
attempt=6```
Arjun: This is expected if audit-forwarders were forced to synchronous egress. Firewall change likely added per-IP conntrack and reduced parallel streams to the keystore cluster. KMS calls are spiking because agents back off slower.
Li: Quick question — do we have a short-lived cache we can enable on agent side to avoid repeated decrypts during bootstrap?
Sasha: We have local ephemeral cache but it was disabled in the rollout for compliance. Need a risk-accepted temporary bypass while we fix network path.
Devon: Mitigation options: 1) Temporarily allowlist agent NAT IPs to keystore egress (fast), 2) rollback firewall rollout for the staging AZs (slower), 3) enable local cache with shorter retention + audit annotation (needs approval).
Arjun: From a compliance POV, 1) allowlist is acceptable for a limited TTR if we log rationale plus audit tags. 3) is preferable long-term but needs signoff.
Li: Operationally, option 1 buys us ~15-30m. Can someone run the allowlist change? I can watch fleet join metrics.
Sasha: @Devon can you open a quick exception ticket and apply allowlist to the 3 affected NAT gateways in usw2a/c? Call it temporary-keystore-allowlist-170123.
Devon: On it. Pushing rule now. 
keystore-bot: ACTION: firewall-rule-change applied: allow outbound to keystore-prod cluster (10.23.45.0/24) from nat-ids [nat-0a1,nat-0b2,nat-0c3] by Devon at 18:16 UTC.
Li: Seeing immediate drop in decrypt errors and node join latency improving. Pool join time median down from 320s -> 68s over 5m. :thumbsup:
Sasha: Nice. Next: we should tune client retry/backoff to reduce KMS QPS during cascades and add conntrack-oriented iptables tuning in the rollout doc.
Arjun: Also capture this in the audit record: why we allowed outbound, approval chain, and planned rollback timeframe (TTR = 6 hours). I can add the compliance note.
Devon: Filing follow-up PR to rollout docs with conntrack and keystore QPS appendix. Will include control to enable ephemeral local cache with audit-tag header if needed.
Li: For postmortem: run a load test of keystore with the new egress posture + verify per-NAT conntrack limits under bootstrap pattern.
Sasha: Agreed. Thanks team — keeping the allowlist for now while we complete testing and patch the rollout. I'll create the incident postmortem doc and link audit logs.
Arjun: I'll attach the compliance note + timestamped approval.
Devon: Deployed rollback window scheduled if no objections by 18:45 UTC.
Li: Monitoring continues, alerted if errors > baseline.
Sasha: Closing thread for now; follow-ups in the postmortem doc.
